title: Crumbly Crafted
description: A performance-focused modpack dedicated to achieving the highest possible FPS through rigorous optimization and the inclusion of sophisticated utility features.
body:
Stop settling for low frames and stuttering. **Crumbly Crafted** is a meticulously crafted collection of mods designed to push the Minecraft engine to its absolute limits. Whether you are playing on a high-end rig or a "potato" laptop, this pack ensures your game runs like butter without sacrificing the soul of the experience.

**_We’ve replaced the inefficient vanilla rendering engine with cutting-edge optimizations._**

- Frame Rates: Expect a 2x to 5x increase in FPS compared to vanilla.

- Stutter Reduction: Optimized memory usage and "lazy-loading" features to eliminate lag spikes.

- Fast Loading: Get from the launcher to your world in record time.

**_Performance doesn't have to be ugly. This pack includes:_**

- Shader Support: Fully compatible with your favorite shaders (Iris included).

- Enhanced Details: Better grass, connected textures, and smooth lighting.

- Fog & Depth: Tweaked atmospheric effects to make the world feel immersive.

**_Built for the player who wants a "complete" experience:_**

- Zoom Function: No more squinting at distant mountains.

- Better UI: Cleaner menus, dark mode support, and organized inventories.

- Utility Tools: Precise coordinates, item search, and borderless windowed mode.
